Mutation ledger — 2026-09-05

Updated four open planning tickets through the rebar MCP tracker surface; no claim, transition, plan review, code edit, test execution, commit, or push was performed.

- `linguistic-dental-eyra`: replaced description with the immutable `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e` 60-block/11-path audit, corrected rotation/unblock scopes and consumers, rewrote all 11 file-impact reasons, and recorded 6 DD-labeled verify commands.
- `easy-crabbed-avocet`: replaced description with the immutable 3-block/3-path audit, separated five executable offline workflow nodes from two collection-only live Jira nodes, rewrote all 3 reasons, and recorded 7 verify commands.
- `improbable-crimson-hare`: replaced description with the immutable 74-block/18-path audit (correcting the unsupported 75 count), split broad scopes around inline prose/directives, rewrote all 18 reasons, and recorded 6 verify commands.
- `syllabic-humoristic-tarantula`: replaced description with the immutable 91-block/12-path audit, corrected graph-perf drift and ownership/shim contracts, rewrote all 12 reasons, and recorded 6 verify commands.

Each plan now defines stable symbol/code block IDs, immutable-base AST/runtime/directive/shebang comparison, exact leaf changed-path equality, independent one-row-per-block TSV review, focused checks, path-scoped diff integrity, and no-timeout worktree-venv `make verify`. The unrelated `origin/main` advance to `10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396` is explicitly excluded from audit identity. MCP readback confirmed every description, impact array, and verify-command array exactly; all writes reported push_status=ok with no description or cross-session warnings.
